name: color/blue-900
description:
UNDRR corporate blue. Also DELTA's brand blue: DELTA's own design file labels this swatch "UNDRR Blue - Corporate blue" and marks it Brand.

CSS: --mg-color-blue-900

name: color/button-background
description:
Colour-valued, not a channel triplet: DELTA needs `transparent` here and a triplet cannot express it. Consumers must not wrap this in rgb().

CSS: --mg-color-button-background

name: border-color/button
description:
Must be a colour, not a channel triplet: it is consumed inside a `border:` shorthand, and a bare triplet makes the whole declaration invalid, which silently drops border-style to none. .mg-button-outline rendered as bare text for the entire time this was a triplet.

CSS: --mg-border-color-button

name: border-color/button-primary
description:
Stroke on filled primary buttons. The fill is painted under the border, so `transparent` makes the stroke match the fill and keeps filled and outline buttons the same size. A theme can set a colour here (for example a darker shade of the fill) to give filled buttons a visible edge.

CSS: --mg-border-color-button-primary

name: border-color/button-secondary
description:
Stroke on filled secondary buttons. See border-color.button-primary.

CSS: --mg-border-color-button-secondary

name: form-input/border-color
description:
The border was rgb(neutral-600 / 0.22), which is 1.43:1 against the page and 1.39:1 against the field's own fill, so every input, textarea and select in the system failed WCAG 1.4.11. neutral-400 is 3.96:1.

CSS: --mg-form-input-border-color

name: brand/primary
description:
UNDRR Blue. DELTA's own design system labels this swatch "UNDRR Blue - Corporate blue" and marks it Brand. 54 uses in DELTA's code, 1551 fills and 1645 strokes in its Figma file. It is rgb(0 79 145), identical to Mangrove's --mg-color-blue-900: DELTA's brand blue is UNDRR's.

Only defined by: delta, irp, preventionweb.

name: brand/primary-800
description:
Hover/active partner of the brand blue, 9 uses in DELTA. Note it is LIGHTER than the base colour, unlike Mangrove's convention of darkening on hover. That is DELTA's actual behaviour, not an error.

Only defined by: delta.

name: brand/secondary
description:
UNDRR Teal, DELTA's secondary brand colour. Mangrove previously mapped the secondary button to the same blue as the primary, collapsing a genuine two-colour brand into one.

Only defined by: delta.

name: brand/secondary-800
description:
Hover partner of UNDRR Teal, taken one step DOWN the teal ramp in DELTA's design file (#002323 #004646 #006968 #007B7A #00AFAE). DELTA's stylesheet uses #359999 here, a step UP, but white text on that is 3.40:1 and fails WCAG 1.4.3. #006968 is 6.52:1 and comes from DELTA's own ramp, so this is a deliberate, sourced divergence rather than an invented colour — the same call already made for DELTA's field border.

Only defined by: delta.

name: brand/ink
description:
Body text and overlay/shadow base.

Only defined by: delta.

name: brand/card-surface
description:
Card / subtle surface fill. #f2f2f2 appears 11 times in DELTA; #fafafa, which Mangrove previously guessed, appears once.

Only defined by: delta.

name: brand/blue-800
description:
Deeper partner of the IRP interactive blue. Carries the secondary button fill and, since the primary button's hover left the orange accent, that hover too. White on it is 6.02:1 and 71.1 perceptually, so it clears AA either way, and it sits 6.6 dE2000 from the interactive blue — comfortably past the ~2.3 just-noticeable difference, and of the same order as the base theme's own blue-900 to blue-700 hover (12.2).

Only defined by: irp.

name: brand/green
description:
IRP green, used only by the tab surface — the tabbar rail, the active tab fill and its borders.

Only defined by: irp.

name: brand/purple
description:
MCR2030 purple. The interactive colour.

Only defined by: mcr.

name: brand/purple-800
description:
Hover/active partner of the brand purple.

Only defined by: mcr.

name: brand/purple-200
description:
Tab border tint.

Only defined by: mcr.

name: brand/teal-800
description:
Lighter partner of the brand teal. Carries the secondary button fill and, since the primary button's hover left the orange accent, that hover too. White on it is 5.5:1 and 69.7 perceptually, so it clears AA either way, and it sits 4.2 dE2000 from the brand teal — comfortably past the ~2.3 just-noticeable difference, though a shallower step than the base theme's own blue-900 to blue-700 hover (12.2).

Only defined by: preventionweb.
